notes: family: auction-money (final score = cash after investor deduction). Order: final income, sell goods (10 each), cash City Keys, hub-city bonus, contracts (only if Wien-Trieste connected), tolls, then 10% of money per shareholder (10 shareholders = 0; more than 10 goes negative). Rulebook gives no tiebreaker. The shareholders row computes a negative deduction from the other rows (cat_ identifiers); it is the last category. Gold/silver key values and hub influence come from the board state.
